name: Pasta Tie Bow and Beef
description: A hearty pasta dish with sautéed beef, mushrooms, and red peppers, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb (340 g) sirloin steak, sliced into thin strips
1 red pepper, cut into ¾ inch squares

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta in boiling water with 1 tsp cooking oil and salt for about 12 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Heat wok on medium-high. Add 1 Tbsp cooking oil and stir-fry beef strips until desired doneness. Transfer to bowl.
Add another 1 Tbsp cooking oil to the wok. Stir-fry mushrooms, red pepper, and crushed chilies for 2 to 3 minutes until tender.
Add beef back into the wok and heat through. Stir in Parmesan cheese.
Spread cooked pasta on a plate and spoon the beef mixture over top. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese.

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Spaghetti Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti casserole with ground beef, canned tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion in a frying pan.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour canned tomatoes over the spaghetti layer.
Spoon the browned meat mixture over the tomatoes.
Cover with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered, until cheese starts to get bubbly.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti casserole, ground beef, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce
